title: Marvin Mims: Extension would be sweet, but you can't keep everybody

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Marvin Mims: Extension would be sweet, but you can't keep everybody
sources.description: Broncos wide receiver Marvin Mims was part of Sean Payton's first draft class in Denver, but he doesn't know if this will be his final year playing for the head coach.
